title: Fevereiro Tem Data
summary: Kairos receives its 2027 preparation calendar: January 4 resumes competitive preparation and February 8 begins the primary debut window, but no first match is confirmed.
keyEvents: The primary 2027 competitive debut window begins on 2027-02-08; this is not a confirmed match date.
January 2027 is structured around competitive simulation; League full series simulation starts in the second week.
Counter-Strike uses external practice and match-format simulation.
League Academies prepare for Tier 2 qualification pathways; no slot is guaranteed.
Counter-Strike Academy may enter suitable open leagues or qualifiers, subject to age and eligibility; permanent positions remain undefined.
2026-12-19 is the final full mandatory day; institutional break runs from 2026-12-20 through 2027-01-03.
Competitive preparation resumes on 2027-01-04; first opponent and exact match date remain TBD.
No official Kairos match has occurred.
